Package com.saicone.nbt.io

Class TagOutput<T>

java.lang.Object
com.saicone.nbt.io.TagOutput<T>
Type Parameters:
T - the tag object implementation.
All Implemented Interfaces:
Closeable, AutoCloseable
public class TagOutput<T> extends Object implements Closeable
Tag Output
A tag output provides methods for converting multiples data formats from any tag object to a delegated DataOutput.
